title: Passing Tests, Missing Semantics: Evidence of Interpretive Lock-In in Plan-Based DataFrame Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.15797v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Planning and revision are intended to bring generated code closer to the task specification. Yet a mistaken interpretation can persist across the plan, implementation, and tests - a pattern we call interpretive lock-in. We investigate this risk on 30 DataFrame tasks derived from TPC Benchmark DS, comparing Frozen One-Pass, Test-Guided Revision, and PlanAudit-Guided Revision. Test-pass counts rose from 22/30 to 29/30 and 30/30, yet no generated solution matched its stored reference output. Evaluator controls returned the expected outcome in 57/57 cases. Same-engine SQL re-execution reproduced 28/30 references; all 77 test-passing runs on these tasks still failed reference agreement. PlanAudit-Guided Revision improved code scores on 3/30 tasks and test coverage on 11/30, but the median paired change was zero for both measures. translated_title: 通过测试却缺失语义：基于计划的DataFrame代码生成中“解释性锁定”现象的证据
translated_abstract: 规划与修订旨在使生成的代码更贴近任务规范。然而，一种错误的解释可能贯穿规划、实现与测试的全过程而持续存在——我们将这种模式称为“解释性锁定”。我们在从TPC基准DS派生的30个DataFrame任务上研究了这一风险，比较了冻结单次生成、测试引导修订与计划审计引导修订三种方法。测试通过数量从22/30分别提升至29/30和30/30，然而没有任何生成的解决方案与其存储的参考输出相匹配。评估器对照在57/57的情况下返回了预期结果；同引擎SQL重新执行复现了28/30的参考输出。在这些任务上，全部77次通过测试的运行仍然未能与参考结果一致。计划审计引导修订在3/30的任务上提升了代码得分，在11/30的任务上提升了测试覆盖率，但两项指标的成对变化中位数均为零。失败分析揭示了测试中存在的问题：遗漏需求、采用由候选代码自定义的模式、使用无区分性的……
tldr: 该研究揭示了LLM代码生成中的“解释性锁定”现象——对任务的错误理解会贯穿规划、实现和测试全过程，导致即使测试全部通过，生成的代码语义仍与参考输出不符。
en_tdlr: This study reveals "interpretive lock-in" in LLM code generation—misinterpretations of task specifications persist across planning, implementation, and testing, so all tests can pass while generated code still fails to match reference outputs semantically.
